justification: Both surfaces depict red-painted, highly schematic stick-figure anthropomorphs with a vertical linear body, splayed legs and raised arms bent upward, accompanied by long straight staff/line elements crossing the figure and small schematic quadruped/comb-like animal forms — a fairly specific shared convention of rendering. The main difference is that A is a crowded multi-figure scene with several humans, a concentric-circle disc and boat/sledge-like signs distributed over the panel, whereas B isolates a single large figure with one small adjacent animal.
